profile.headline: Senior .NET Engineer | Purging Latency with C# & High-Performance Rites | Sanctifying APIs for Sub-Millisecond Deliverance
profile.summary:
Diligent full-stack senior software engineer with 8 years of experience in developing business applications used by judges, clerks, attorneys, and filers across the U.S. I have assisted in building and maintaining these highly complex, configurable, and critical application solutions. 

I currently work primarily in the .NET ecosystem, developing systems with the C# programming language, T-SQL a the primary database language, and AngularJS as a front-end framework.

I am eager to continue expanding my knowledge set, and am currently developing small projects with other frameworks such as Svelete, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, and Rust.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · C# · HTML5 · JavaScript · .NET Framework · Vue.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Participating in the technical design of new applications and existing system enhancements while providing a high-level analysis of system designs. Developing highly complex application solutions that enhance existing solutions while meeting end-user demands. Providing guidance to less experienced team members to ensure knowledge transfer and clear up operational deficiencies. Executing critical root cause analysis on time-sensitive production problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in the technical design of new applications and existing system enhancements. Performed maintenance coding on existing applications. Provided technical backing to the support team to troubleshoot and resolve end-user problems.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: My primary responsibility is to help in maintaining an enterprise level application. This was accomplished by being available for scheduled deployments and upgrades, in addition to working on enhancement requests and bug fixes.

positions.title: Customer Service Trainer/Supervisor
positions.description: As a trainer my duties include new hire orientation with product knowledge training, basic system training in client database, side-by-side coaching, and quality assurance follow-ups. My responsibilities as a supervisor are to assist the 4-6 managers with their teams needs. This includes: assign/delegate tasks and/or jobs, train employees, enforce rules, lead and motivate team, solve daily problems, and control and evaluate performance of employees.

positions.title: Customer Service Team Lead
positions.description: In addition to my duties as a customer support engineer, I was responsible for assisting in the management of a small team of 10 agents. Specifically I was responsible for carrying out policies passed down from the manager, ensure performance standards were met, and assist subordinates with jobs and/or tasks.

positions.title: Customer Support Engineer
positions.description:
My responsibility was to assist customers, over the phone, to resolve their complaint, issue, or question with our clients product. My duties included taking, on average, 10 calls an hour, knowledge and understanding of DSI and DTI database systems, customer service phone etiquette, the handling of critical issues, and meeting company performance standards. Calls would range from simple customer service questions to retention or sales calls.

I was also hired on to provide technical support for customers accessing our clients product through computers, iPad, iPhone, and/or any Android devices. Technical support duties included resolving registration, connection, and/or device issues.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: My duties include assisting customers in their selection of rentals and other purchases. Responsibilities would also include management of various store projects, providing product knowledge of movies, games, and other products, and driving sales/performance goals.

positions.title: Telecommunications Student Worker
positions.description: Temporary position that involved assisting the telecommunications department in a special project. The duties and responsibilities included replacing and updating administration contact information, then transferring that information into a new database.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

projects.title: Android Application
projects.description: An Android mobile application that was started as a final project for my Mobile App Development class. I plan to continue work on this app and have it published to the Google Play Store.
